mainText: Hello, Verona! At 4 AM, here is today's balanced dish: it is 46 degrees and overcast near the Military Ridge State Trail under a full moon, and while the International Space Station passes overhead tonight, you will not be able to see it due to the clouds.

The Wisconsin Department of Transportation is seeking public feedback on the US 18/151 Corridor Study, with both an in-person meeting on November 18 at Mount Horeb High School and a virtual option on November 19 to discuss initial design concepts.

There is plenty to do in Verona, starting with trivia today at Hop Haus and Wisconsin Brewing Company, followed by tomorrow's events including trivia at Paddy Mac's, live music, yoga at Insight Wellness, and pizza at Lake Lou-ee.

In a report covering October 18 through October 25, officers arrested a man for O W I on October 25 after he was found unresponsive in his vehicle at the intersection of Plympton Street and Rita Avenue.
Satisfy your sweet tooth today with the Chocolate Caramel Twist, which is today's featured flavor at Culver's, where they will open their doors today at 10:00 AM.
